description: Requests a permission for the person (or their agent): whoever can grant it decides in while.

days.description: Duration, in days; not used for an app (for), whose right has no expiry.

for.description: For an app that will call a connection: app:<project>/<service> or task:<project>/<task>, role connection-caller (or connection-writer), scope { connection }.

permission.description: Or a permission (the smallest role that grants it).

reason.description: Why ("Q4 audit"), read by whoever decides.

renew.description: One of your assignments to extend (only days and reason count).

scope.description: {}: the organization; otherwise down to a table, or a connection.

tool.description: Or the id of a reserved tool (view existing).

name: request_access
title: Request access
